docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: User Select Filters
docs.text: Since v0.28, AppCOM allows User selection lists to be filtered in order to limit the Users that can be assigned to any particular field.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
Let's use the selection of a Work Order's Form One Inspector as an example of how to limit the Users that can be selected as the Form One Inspector.

When the Select User dialog is opened, notice the Filter Name QaInspectors is specified. This means "Only Users that match the QaInspectors filter criteria will be displayed in this dialog".

A Filter Name is programmed into AppCOM for most User Select dialogs.

docs.title: Set Filter Criteria
docs.text:
The basic steps are as follows:

  1. (Optional) Create a new User Tag that can be assigned to users.
  2. (Optional) Assign the new User Tag to any users you want to be included in the selection.
  3. Set filter criterion, including optionally assigning the new User Tag to the User Select control's filter.

docs.title: Create User Tag
docs.text:
Do this only if the user select dialog warrants finer control over the selection of users. In many cases, existing tags can be used, or simply just specifying a set of user properties is sufficient.

In the AppCOM Settings Manager - Authorization - User Settings panel, create a new User Tag called FormOneInspector (the name doesn't really matter, but should be unique and descriptive).

This tag will be assigned to the Users that can be selected as Form One Inspectors and applied to the User selection control.

Note

Make sure to not leave spaces between tags. Make sure to save your changes (green check mark).

docs.title: Assign User Tag to Users
docs.text:
Go back to the Work Order form and open the Inspector User Select dialog:

Next, click on the User Tags button:

Select the Users to whom you want to assign the tag, then right click and select Add Tags to selected Users...

The Select User Tags dialog will open. Check the the FormOneInspector tag we created earlier.

When you close the dialog, you'll notice the Select User list is empty. We have to apply the tag to the Inspector User Select dialog.

docs.title: Assign Tag to Filter
docs.text:
Click on the Filter button:

In the User Select Filter dialog, check the the FormOneInspector tag in the User Muts Be Assigned To All Of section:

After closing the dialog, you'll notice only Users that have been assigned the tag are displayed.

docs.title: Extra Info
docs.text:
• User Filters are global in nature.
  • Filters can be modified only by AppCOM Administrators or Users that have been assigned the UserSelectFilters permission.

docs.title: Under The Hood
docs.text:
• The User Filters are stored in the database table appcom.user_select_filters.
  • The User Select dialog is implemented in AppCOM\src\ac2data\widgets\userselect-widget.cpp.

docs.title: Default View Settings
docs.text: AppCOM now allows users to save the visibility, order and widths of columns in table and tree views to a file.

docs.title: File
docs.text:
By default, the default view settings are saved to appcom-view-defaults.json in the user's AppCOM folder.

The file can be copied to share with other users.

The file to use can be specified in the Tools - Edit Preferences... menu:

My Settings - Views Defaults File.

docs.title: Set View's Visible Columns
docs.text:
Use the Select View Columns... item in the view's column menu.

Select the columns you wish to have displayed in the view.

docs.title: Save View
docs.text: When the view has been tailored to your liking (after selecting the visible columns, arranging their order and adjusting their widths), use the Save View to Defaults... item in the view's column menu.

docs.title: Restore View
docs.text:
Use the Set View to Saved Defaults... item in the view's column menu.

Note

If the view has not been previously saved, the Set View to Saved Defaults... menu item will be disabled.

docs.title: Searching
docs.text:
The search bar found in many of the table views supports regular expressions.

When you enter a search term and press Enter, all of the visible columns in the view are included in the search.

docs.title: Begins With ^
docs.text:
Example:

Firstly, we search for PSUB- and note that many rows are returned that contain PSUB- in either the Part# or Allocated column.

To narrow the search to just PSUB- Part#s, we can add the begins with regex pattern ^ to the search term:

docs.title: Ends With $
docs.text:
Search for 0477:

Ends with 0477:

Tip

If you want to search for a $ or ^, you need to escape it with \ Eg. \$ will return rows that have columns containing $ in their text.

docs.title: Match Any Character .
docs.text: .+ One or more characters: CAP-.+

docs.title: Examples
docs.text: Begins with CAB and ends with REV A: ^CAB.+REV A$

docs.title: Assets Manager
docs.text: This page contains notes about the more obscure features of the Assets Manager.

docs.title: Notifications
docs.text:
Introduced in v33.2.1

Users can be setup to receive notifications when an Asset is due for calibration.

A user can be notified for specific Assets and/or added to the default Asset notification list.

A notification interval can also be set which specifies the number of days before a calibration is due to notify the recipients.

docs.title: Default Notification List
docs.text:
Recipients and a notification interval are set in the Settings Manager.

These people will be notified for all Asset calibrations that are coming due.

docs.title: Individual Asset Notification
docs.text:
In the Asset edit form, recipients can be added to the notification list and the notification interval can be overridden.

Example 1 - Use Default Notification Interval

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
In Example 1 above:

  • Scott will be notified 7 days before a calibration is due for all Assets.
  • Scott & Mike will be notified 7 days before the next calibration is due for the Asset being edited.

Example 2 - Override Notification Interval

  • Scott & Mike will be notified 30 days before the next calibration is due for the Asset.

docs.title: Ecrs Manager
docs.text: This page contains notes about the more obscure features of the Ecrs Manager.

docs.title: Notification List
docs.text:
New in v33.5.1

  • The list of Document Types that can be assigned to a Department are defined in AppCOM Settings - Ecrs - Ecr Notification Departments.
  • For notification purposes, a user can be assigned to more than one department in AppCOM Settings - Authorization - Department Members.

docs.title: Project
docs.text:
New in v33.2.1

When the Project is changed, the Project Phase field is updated to reflect the current disposition from the Project's corresponding Project Lifecycle record.

docs.title: Text Fields
docs.text:
New in v33.2.1

The Problem and Solution fields can be double clicked to open a larger text edit dialog.

Text Edit Dialog

docs.title: Non Conformances Manager
docs.text:
This page contains notes about the more obscure features of the NCRs Manager.

Introduced in v33.1.1

docs.title: Formatting Text
docs.text:
The various box text editors have the following features:

  • Double clicking opens a text edit dialog.

  • Support for html, for example:

    Bold <b>Bold</b>

    Italic <i>Italic</i>

    Underline <u>Underline</u>

docs.title: Box 1.f Non Conformance
docs.text:
Optional Non Conformance Summary text can be specified. The summary text will be printed on the pdf only if Print Summary is checked:

TextPdf Output

It is displayed in the log in the Summary column:

docs.title: Box 3.f Root Cause
docs.text:
Separate 3.f.n items can be specified by starting a line with ---

TextPdf Output

docs.title: Box 3.h External Product Affected?
docs.text:
TextPdf Output

Default text for this box can be inserted via the context menu:

Note

The default text can be set in in the AppCOM Settings/QA panel.

docs.title: Setting Completed Status
docs.text:
Use the NCR view's context menu to set/clear the completed status for selected NCR records.

Note

The status can be modified only by AppCOM Administrators or Users in groups that have been assigned to the Ncrs Advanced task in AppCOM Settings.

docs.title: Generating Pdf
docs.text:
Note

The default folder location where you are prompted to save NCR pdfs can be set in in the AppCOM Settings/QA panel.

docs.title: Reject Tags
docs.text:
To create a reject tag for a specific Part# associated with the NCR, select the Part# first, then create the Reject Tag.

The Part# and other associated fields will automatically be filled in.

Currently, reject tag pdfs are saved in your AppCOM temp folder.

To Do

  • Save reject tags to the default folder.

docs.title: Orders Manager
docs.text: This page contains notes about the more obscure features of the Orders Manager.

docs.title: Sales Orders By Country
docs.text:
Introduced in v33.2.1

  • Lists sales orders total dollar amounts grouped by country.
  • Can be toggled on/off from the Order Tracking menu item in the main menu bar when the Orders Manager is active.

Note

The data displayed in the view is generated from the filtered Sales Orders data.

docs.title: Country Aliases
docs.text: Country Aliases allow you to group countries stored in Simply Accounting together. Aliases are required, due to the fact that data is entered inconsistently into Simply.

docs.title: Enabled
docs.text:
To see the data with country aliases grouped together, check Use Country Aliases.

Country Aliases Enabled

In this view, the country totals are summed together with the alias totals (eg Brazil + Brasil)

docs.title: Disabled
docs.text:
To see the raw data without country aliases grouped together, uncheck Use Country Aliases.

Country Aliases Disabled

In this view, if the country is an alias, the country it has been assigned to is shown in (brackets).

docs.title: Adding Aliases
docs.text:
Use the view's context menu to add/remove aliases.

As an example, Brasil can be made an alias for Brazil in one of three ways:

docs.title: First Method:
docs.text: In this example, the country Brazil is assigned to the alias Brasil. Right click on Brasil

docs.title: Second Method:
docs.text: In this example, the alias Brasil is added to the country Brazil. Right click on Brazil

docs.title: Third Method:
docs.text: Use the Country Aliases Management Dialog. Choose Manage Aliases ... from the context menu.

docs.title: Managing Aliases
docs.text: Country Aliases Management Dialog

docs.title: Under The Hood
docs.text: • The Country Aliases are stored in the database table appcom.country_aliases.

docs.title: Parts Manager
docs.text: This page contains notes about the more obscure features of the Parts Manager.

docs.title: Setting Part PPL Order
docs.text:
Other than setting a PPL as PPL#1, there is no other way to order the PPLs.

If you want to have them listed in a specific order, you need to make each PPL the #1 PPL in the reverse order in which you want them numbered.

In the example above, first make IPS1041LPBF PPL#1, then IPS2041LPBF PPL#1 and so on, lastly making ZXMS6006DGTA PPL#1.

docs.title: Parts Lists Manager
docs.text: This page contains notes about the more obscure features of the Parts Lists Manager.

docs.title: Metal Report
docs.text:
Introduced in v33.4.5

By default, only Parts that have their PPL#1 Primary Material set to either Steel or Aluminum are displayed in the report.

To see all the parts, check the Show Non Metal Parts box at the top of the report. Note that non metal parts are not included in the metal summary.

In the Metal Summary, the countries are listed in descending order by total value.

docs.title: Fab Parts vs Purchased Parts
docs.text:
A part is considered a Fab Part when it has its PPL#1 Manufacturer set to JAC. All other parts are considered purchased parts.

When calculating the metal content value for a Fab Part, the Part's net weight is multiplied by the price of Aluminum or Steel that has been set in the Settings Manager.

When calculating the metal content value for a Purchased Part, the Part's inventory price is used.

docs.title: Global Metal Prices
docs.text: Set in the Settings Manager

docs.title: Editing Data
docs.text:
The following data can be edited directly from the Metal Report:

  • Part PPL#1 Data Click on a Part Number to edit its PPL#1. The PPL fields pertaining to this report are most notably:
    • Part Net Weight
    • Primary Material
    • Country Of Origin
    • Substantiating Data

  • Product Weight Click on the Full Weight Of The Product title to open the appropriate editor for the Part List product.

  • Product Value Click on the Total Value Of The Product title to open the appropriate record in the Price List Manager.

docs.title: Purchase Requisitions Manager
docs.text: This page contains notes about the more obscure features of the Preqs Manager.

docs.title: Why isn't the Part selected in the form?
docs.text:
Even though a part has been selected for the line item, it shows up as a Free Hand Line Item when the form is opened.

This is caused when the Part's Manufacturer and the Purchase Req's Vendor are not the same.

Quite possibly, the Part's Manufacturer was changed after it was added to the Preq.

Purchase Requisition Line Item Form

docs.title: Shipping Manager
docs.text: This page contains notes about the more obscure features of the Shipping Manager.

docs.title: Commercial Invoices
docs.text:
New in v33.2.1

Commercial Invoice

Opens a form where you can edit the pertinent Shipping Record data for a Commercial Invoice as well as generate a pdf.

docs.title: Certificates Of Origin
docs.text:
New in v33.2.1

Opens a form where you can edit the pertinent Shipping Record data for a Certificates Of Origin as well as generate a pdf.

Certificate of Origin

Note

Certificate Of Origin and Commercial Invoice pdfs are saved in the record's J:/Shipping Documents/SIxxxx Work Directory. You will want to create the SIxxxx folder before generating the pdfs by clicking on the folder link and selecting Yes.

docs.title: Setting Shipping Item Data
docs.text:
The context menu enables you to quickly set values for multiple shipping item records.

Shipping Items Context Menu

You can also open the item's Part# editor from this menu to set a Part's Shipping Information.

Product Shipping Info

Part PPL#1 Shipping Info

docs.title: Shipping Labels
docs.text:
Shipping Labels can be printed from the following locations:

  1. Work Orders Manager

  2. Parts Manager - PPL - Batch or Work Orders tab.

  3. Receive Inspections Manager

docs.title: Shipping Label Dialog
docs.text:
The Unit of Measure and the Made In Country fields are extracted from the associated Part Number's PPL#1. Press the Edit button to change.

Note

The footer text can be overriden, however it is not saved after printing the label.

docs.title: Email Documents
docs.text: As of v33.1.2, AppCOM allows users to email documents to a list of recipients.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The documents can be chosen from any of the Managers that include a File Browser, such as the Parts and Products Managers.

The documents are sent as attachments in an email to a list of recipients from the Email Files Dialog.

docs.title: Choosing Documents
docs.text:
Select one or more documents in a File Browser, then right click and choose Add Files to Email Queue.

Adding Documents to Email Queue

docs.title: Email Queue
docs.text:
• Is a list of documents that have been chosen on a per user basis, which means that each user will only see the documents that they have chosen.
  • Is persistent between AppCOM sessions.
  • Documents can be removed from the list in the Email Files Dialog.

docs.title: Email Files Dialog
docs.text:
This is where you compose and send emails with document attachments to a list of recipients.

Email Files Dialog

You can open the dialog from either the View Menu, or the context menu in the File Browser.

Tip

The dialog can moved to anywhere on your desktop and does not block you from interacting with other managers.

docs.title: Recipients List
docs.text:
• Is a list of email addresses that are stored on a per user basis, which means that each user will only see the recipients that they have created.
  • Is persistent between AppCOM sessions.
  • Recipients can be created from scratch or added from AppCOM contacts.
  • Recipients can be excluded, which means they will not be included in the email.

docs.title: Adding/Editing Recipients
docs.text: Recipients can be added manually or chosen from an AppCOM Contact.

docs.title: Adding Dealers
docs.text:
All of the Contacts that have their On Dealers Email List property checked can be added in one fell swoop to the Recipients List:

Tip

To display only dealers that are on the Dealers Email List, choose Show On Dealers Email List only in the View Options.

Tip

You can run the Add Dealers On Email List ... function whenever Contacts are added to the Dealers Email List. Duplicates will not be added to the Recipients list.

docs.title: Sending Account
docs.text: This is the email account that will be used to send the email. You can only choose from a list of known accounts within AppCOM.

docs.title: From Name
docs.text: This is the name the end user will see in the From field in their email client. You can override the default account name if you wish.

docs.title: Bcc
docs.text: You can optionally enter a comma separated list of email addresses that you want to be blind carbon copied. For example, you may wish to have a copy of the email sent to yourself.

docs.title: Subject
docs.text: Email subject line.

docs.title: Body
docs.text:
Email body, which supports html markup.

Tip

Double clicking in this field opens a larger text edit dialog.

docs.title: Send Email
docs.text:
The Recipients that are visible in the Recipients List and have been Included are included in the Email.

Clicking on the Send... button will open a confirmation dialog that displays the email particulars:

Confirmation Dialog

docs.title: Send History
docs.text:
A full log of sent emails is maintained by AppCOM. Click on the History icon to display the log.

Note

The log displays emails sent by all users.

docs.title: By Date
docs.text:
Shows sent emails in chronological order.

By Date

docs.title: By Document
docs.text:
Shows documents in alphabetical order along with the dates they were sent in an email. Use Search to find specific documents.

By Document

docs.title: By Recipient
docs.text:
Shows recipients in alphabetical order along with the documents and dates they received an email.

By Recipient

Tip

You can enter a date in order to limit the number of records listed.

docs.title: File Location
docs.text:
The settings file to use is specified in the login window.

  • If you choose a settings file with your username (Eg: AppCOM-myname.ini) the file is used from wherever it resides.

  • If you choose a settings file with someone else's username (Eg: AppCOM-notmyname.ini) from somewhere other than your AppCOM folder, the file is copied to your AppCOM folder and used from there.

docs.title: Saving
docs.text: To save a settings file, use the Tools - Save User Settings menu item.
